description: Presidential Secretariat - Public Corporation, Government Department Local Authority, Co-operative Society etc. into an Essential Public Services
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It constitutes a regulatory/legal measure by the President using statutory powers to designate specific services as essential, which falls under legal/regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes. The content focuses on establishing a legal framework for service operation during potential disruptions, not on appointments, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
